findings.claim: The condition in the field-member loop is inverted: `if (stringMembers.ContainsKey(member.StringKey))` is missing the `!` that the three sibling hunks have. The dictionary starts empty, so `ContainsKey` is false for every new key and no string-keyed field is ever added to `stringMembers`. Example input: a `[MessagePackObject]` class with `[Key("a")] public int MyFieldA;`. The generated formatter silently omits every string-keyed field. Those fields are never serialized and are lost on round-trip, with no diagnostic. On base the same input was generated correctly.

The test asserts the generated sources reference MyFieldA and MyFieldB. Expected: it fails on head and passes once `!` is restored.
